cim: The 3rd Annual Globee® Awards for Artificial Intelligence Invite Product, Service, and Business Achievement Nominations Worldwide
cim_eredeti: The 3rd Annual Globee® Awards for Artificial Intelligence Invite Product, Service, and Business Achievement Nominations Worldwide
szoveg_eredeti:
Recognizing local, regional, and global achievements across AI products, services, solutions, implementations, and workplace innovations that create measurable value across industries

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Globee® Awards announced that nominations are now being accepted for the 3rd Annual Globee® Awards for Artificial Intelligence, inviting organizations and professionals worldwide to nominate achievements involving artificial intelligence products, services, solutions, and business applications.

Learn more and submit nominations at:https://globeeawards.com/artificial-intelligence/

Artificial intelligence is creating new opportunities across industries by helping organizations solve complex problems, improve products and services, enhance customer experiences, advance research, strengthen decision-making, and introduce new capabilities. The Globee® Awards for Artificial Intelligence recognize measurable achievements resulting from the development, application, and implementation of AI.

Nominations may represent achievements involving generative AI, agentic AI, AI agents, enterprise AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, computer vision, predictive analytics, AI infrastructure, data science, AI-powered products and services, business transformation, and other established and emerging applications of artificial intelligence.

Both AI technology providers and organizations using AI are invited to participate. Achievements may involve new or established products, services, platforms, solutions, successful implementations, and business initiatives demonstrating measurable results across industries.

The Globee® Awards have a history of recognizing technology achievements spanning more than two decades, with roots in technology-focused recognition programs dating back to 2003. The Globee® Awards for Artificial Intelligence, now in their third annual edition, build on this broader recognition heritage while focusing specifically on achievements involving artificial intelligence.

The program welcomes nominations representing achievements by professionals, teams, departments, companies and organizations, products and services, and brand, communications, and creative initiatives across industries worldwide.

Local, regional, and global achievements are welcomed, recognizing that meaningful AI accomplishments can originate anywhere and create measurable value at any scale.

Entries are evaluated through a merit-based, data-driven process involving participation from professionals across multiple industries worldwide and defined scoring criteria. Submission of a nomination does not guarantee an award.

The Globee® Awards are organizers of merit-based, data-driven business awards programs with worldwide participation. Across 10 awards programs, the Globee® Awards recognize achievements across multiple industries and sectors. The programs use a structured evaluation approach involving participation from professionals across various industries.
